From frames 20 through 40, the seated dog turns its head toward frame-right and the background. From frames 40 through 80, it holds the same seated pose and rightward head orientation stably. Preserve the source dog's identity, harness, leaves, lighting, background, and camera unless the requested motion physically requires a change.
